objective: Establish the Spell-Family & Variant Grammar: determine when several spells are members of one family rather than unrelated records while preserving separate player-facing spells. Cover element/material variants such as Protection from Fire/Cold/Lightning; form variants such as bolt/burst/wall/aura/weapon/ward; target/scale variants such as single/group/area; progression labels such as lesser/greater; information variants such as detect/locate/analyze; and summon/create/control relationships. Variants may inherit explicit structure but must not impose a universal mathematical formula.

acceptance_profile.family_membership: Define governed family identity, variant dimensions and inheritance semantics without merging distinct player-facing spell records.
acceptance_profile.evidence_basis: Consume SEC-01 duplicate/variant candidates, SEC-02 capability taxonomy and SEC-03 accepted effect-family audit results while retaining source/provenance distinctions.
acceptance_profile.no_universal_formula: Shared family structure may reduce duplication but cannot create universal numeric scaling, automatic balance equivalence or inferred mechanics.
acceptance_profile.authority_boundaries: SEC-05 retains tradition/reality compatibility; SEC-06/07 expansion; SEC-08 balance/progression/usability; SEC-09 final completeness proof.
acceptance_profile.validation: Focused invariant verifier plus exact-head repository health and governed Linux/Windows deterministic Validation Core must pass before merge.
